title: Rundeck: In Eclipse Jetty, across various versions of `jetty-security`, and `jetty-eeN-security`, and… (CVE-2026-18659)
description: A security vulnerability in the Rundeck package affects Eclipse Jetty components including jetty-security, jetty-eeN-security, and jetty-eeN-servlet. The issue allows bypassing Jakarta Spec constraints defined as http-method-omission by using substrings of the defined HTTP methods. This could lead to unintended access control bypass. The vulnerability is fixed in Rundeck version 6.0.1-r11.
